question: ___________war took place during fourth five year plan.
solution:
The correct answer is __**India -Pakistan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India-Pakistan war** took place during the** fourth five-year plan.**
 
• The fourth five-year plan was implemented in India from** 1969 to 1974,** and during this period,** India and Pakistan **fought the war of **1971.**
 
• The war was fought mainly over the** issue of East Pakistan, **which later became **Bangladesh.**
 
• India supported the independence movement of East Pakistan, and Pakistan **opposed it.**
 
• The war lasted for **13 days **and ended with the surrender of around 90,000 Pakistani soldiers.
 
• It resulted in the** liberation of East Pakistan** and the **formation of Bangladesh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indo-China war:**

 
 
• The Indo-China war was fought between India and China in **1962** over the **border dispute** between the two countries.
 
• It resulted in a defeat for India and led to a **strained relationship **between the two countries for many years. 
 
 
 
• **World War II:**
 
 
• World War II was a global conflict that lasted from **1939 to 1945.**
 
• It involved most of the world's major powers and resulted in the** deaths of millions** of people.
 
• The war ended with the defeat of **Germany and Japan** and the emergence of the **United States** and the **Soviet Union** as superpowers.
 
 
 
• **World War I:**
 
 
• World War I was a global war that lasted from **1914 to 1918**.
 
• It involved most of the world's great powers and resulted in the** deaths of millions **of people.
 
• The war ended with the **defeat of Germany **and the formation of the **League of Nations.**
